body.p: This Amendment is in response to the Office Action, dated August 23, 2023 ("Office Action"). Claims 1-26 are pending, claims 22-26 having been withdrawn, and claims 1-4, 18, and 19 having been amended. No new matter is added. Examination of the claims in view of the ensuing remarks is respectfully requested.
Information Disclosure Statement (IDS)

The Examiner states that the information disclosure statement filed 4/20/2023 fails to comply with 37 CFR 1.98(a)(2), specifically, NPL citation 3 lists pages 135-138 of the cited document, but it appears only the abstract of the document was submitted, not the listed pages and is thus not considered. An IDS including the above-identified NPL citation 3 and a copy of the NPL citation 3 are submitted herewith for consideration.
Objection to the Drawings
With regard to the drawings, the Examiner states that:
Figure 1 should be designated by a legend such as -Prior Art--;
Figures 1, 14, 17, and 20B are not discussed in the detailed description;
they do not include the following reference sign(s) mentioned in the description: '220'; and they include the following reference character(s) not mentioned in the description: '420', '880'.
The drawings and the specification have been amended to address the Examiner's concerns and to expedite prosecution of the instant application. Withdrawal of the objections is respectfully requested.
The disclosure is objected to because of the following informalities:
a. The specification [0166] refers to Figures 17A-17C, however, there are no Figures
17A-17C. Is this supposed to be Figure 17 or Figures 18A-18C?
b. [00206]-[00209] refer to specific claims, the specification should not refer to the
specific claims directly and these passages should be amended to remove such reference.
Page 9 of 11
The specification has been amended in view of the Examiner's comments to expedite prosecution of the instant application. Withdrawal of the objection is respectfully requested.

Claims 1, 4, and 18 are objected to for reasons of record. Claims 1, 4, and 18 have been amended as suggested by the Examiner to expedite prosecution of the instant application. Withdrawal of the objection is respectfully requested.
Examiner rejects claim 18 as allegedly being indefinite for reasons of record. Applicant respectfully traverses this rejection.
Claim 18 has been amended to address the Examiner's concerns and to expedite prosecution of the instant application. Withdrawal of the rejections is respectfully requested.

18. Examiner rejects claims 1-2, 5, 11-14, and 16-17 as allegedly being anticipated by Dennis et al. (Dennis, US 2017/0074857) for reasons of record. 19. Examiner rejects claims 1 and 15 as allegedly being anticipated by Pierry et al. (Pierry, US 2004/0186391) for reasons of record. Applicant respectfully traverses this rejection.

While Applicant does not concede to the merits of the rejections, in an effort to advance prosecution of the present application, independent claim 1 has been amended. Claim 1, as currently amended, recites "the at least one gas sensor comprises a CH4 sensor" among others. Neither Dennis nor Pierry discloses this feature recited in amended claim 1. Accordingly, amended claim 1 and its dependent claims are allowable over the cited references. In view of the foregoing, Applicant respectfully requests reconsideration and withdrawal of the rejections.

23. Examiner rejects claims 6-8 as allegedly being unpatentable over Dennis in view of Saatchi et al. (Saatchi, US 2013/0165810) for reasons of record. 24. Examiner rejects claims 1, 18- 19, 21 as allegedly being unpatentable over Gupta et al. (US 2018/0271404) in view of Dennis for reasons of record. 25. Examiner rejects claim 20 as allegedly being unpatentable over Gupta in
Page 10 of 11

view of Dennis, and further in view of Pimentel et al. (Pimentel, WO 2018/156937 Al) for reasons of record. 26. Examiner rejects claims 3-4 and 9-10 as allegedly being unpatentable over Pierry in view of Gupta for reasons of record. Applicant respectfully traverses this rejection.

As discussed above, Dennis and Pierry fail to disclose that "the at least one gas sensor comprises a CH4 sensor," as recited in amended claim 1. Moreover, Saatchi, Gupta, and Pimentel fail to cure the above-identified deficiencies of Dennis and Pierry with respect to amended claim 1. Accordingly, amended claim 1 and its dependent claims are allowable over the cited references. In view of the foregoing, Applicant respectfully requests reconsideration and withdrawal of this rejection.

All of the claims in the application are now believed to be allowable. Favorable consideration and a Notice of Allowance are earnestly solicited. If questions remain regarding this application, the Examiner is invited to contact the undersigned at (213) 629-6000.

The Commissioner is hereby authorized to charge any required fees to Deposit Account No. 50-4181. The Commissioner is further authorized to charge any deficiency or credit any overpayment to Deposit Account No. 50-4181.
Respectfully submitted, Mark Pimentel et al.
